_meta.description: Submit a prompt to DeepSeek and capture the response.
_meta.notes: DeepSeek uses div[role=button] not <button>; DOM fully obfuscated (no aria-label/data-testid). Send button = .ds-button--primary.ds-button--filled (updated 2026-07-10 WQ-164; old ds-icon-button--sizing-container stale). Completion signal (2026-07-10 WQ-164, corrected via mutation diagnostic): while generating, the composer's primary button shows a .ds-loading spinner; the button also carries .ds-button--disabled BOTH during streaming AND when idle, so disabled-state does NOT mark completion — the spinner appearing (s5a) then vanishing (s5b) does. Read the ANSWER via .ds-assistant-message-main-content (NOT .ds-markdown — with DeepThink ON that first-matches the chain-of-thought inside .ds-think-content). CAVEAT: DeepThink reasoning can run 30-60s, so a full run routinely exceeds the ~60s MCP synchronous cap even though the chain itself is correct — verify via a fire-and-forget/async runner or disable DeepThink; the spinner-gone completion signal correctly waits through reasoning. Cloudflare Turnstile present — CDP isTrusted click confirmed to work.

params.prompt: Say hello in exactly one sentence.

prompt_input.description: Native textarea — placeholder='Message DeepSeek' confirmed by DOM probe

send_button.description: Send button — div[role=button].ds-button--primary.ds-button--filled (class updated 2026-07-10 WQ-164; old ds-icon-button--sizing-container is stale). :not(.ds-button--disabled) = enabled/has-text.

chain.note: Start a fresh chat to avoid leftover state
wait for prompt_input before next step (was delay 1500ms)
Type prompt — nativeInputValueSetter sets React state. No submit:true; explicit click follows.
wait for send_button before next step (was delay 200ms)
Click send button explicitly — more reliable than Enter for React+Cloudflare

Streaming STARTED: the composer's primary button shows a .ds-loading spinner while DeepSeek generates (verified via mutation diagnostic 2026-07-10 WQ-164). onTimeout:continue covers a near-instant answer whose spinner we miss.

Streaming DONE: the .ds-loading spinner disappears when generation completes. This is the real completion signal — NOTE (2026-07-10 WQ-164): the button carries .ds-button--disabled BOTH while streaming and when idle, so disabled-state is NOT a completion signal; the spinner appearing then vanishing is. Replaces the old 45s fixed delay.
Settle on the rendered ANSWER container. Fix 2026-07-10 WQ-164: old 'main,#app,#root' settle resolved instantly (read fired before DOM commit → null).

Read the ANSWER, not the reasoning. Fix 2026-07-10 WQ-164: DeepThink is ON for this account, so the response has a chain-of-thought .ds-markdown inside .ds-think-content (first match) AND the answer in .ds-assistant-message-main-content. The old '[class*=ds-markdown]:last-of-type' was doubly wrong — :last-of-type matches last-of-TAG (not last matching el, so it resolved to null) and the plain fallback grabbed the reasoning. .ds-assistant-message-main-content uniquely selects the answer.
